package example.bankwealth.v2.domain.entities

import net.imadz.common.CborSerializable

object FundOrderEntity {
  final case class State(netAmount: BigDecimal, paymentOutcome: String, taStatus: String)

  def empty: State = State(
    netAmount = BigDecimal("0.00"),
    paymentOutcome = "pending",
    taStatus = "pending"
  )

  def empty(netAmount: BigDecimal): State = empty.copy(netAmount = netAmount)

  sealed trait Event extends CborSerializable
  final case class CashRequestSourceRecorded(principal: String, clientRequestId: String) extends Event
  final case class FundPurchaseSettlementRequested(principal: String, clientRequestId: String) extends Event
  final case class FundTASharesConfirmed(shares: Long, nav: BigDecimal) extends Event
  final case class IndependentRefundRequested(orderId: String) extends Event

  type EventHandler = (State, Event) => State
}
